steps.text: Talk to Abigale in the south east corner of Lumbridge Swamp.
Board the rowboat south of Abigale.
Pick up the bucket near the fountain.
Search the barrel of rainwater north of the fountain to trigger a cutscene.
Use the bucket on the barrel of rainwater.
Search the barrel of rainwater for the manor key.
Enter the manor.
Take the knife from the table.
Try to open the door with the pink handle.
Pick up the note that appeared.
Read the notes.
Use a knife on the marked painting.
Search the painting for a ruby key.
Go through the door with the ruby handle.
Search the shelves for a tinderbox.
Light the unlit candles in the room.
Light the unlit candles in the room.
Light the unlit candles in the room.
Light the unlit candles in the room.
Light the fuse on the barrel.
Leave the room to trigger the explosion.
Climb over the damaged wall.
Observe Lacey through the trees.
Pick up the note that appeared by the fence.
Read the notes.
Play the D key.
Play the E key.
Play the A key.
Play the D key again.
Unfortunately you've played an incorrect key. Restart.
Play the piano in the room to the south for the emerald key.
Right-click search the piano for the emerald key.
Climb back over the damaged wall into the manor.
Go through the door with the green handle.
Try to enter the room containing the Bandos godsword.
Pick up the note that appeared by the door.
Read the notes.
Use a knife on the unlit fireplace in the eastern room.
You've clicked a gem in the wrong order. Try restarting.
Click the sapphire.
Click the diamond.
Click the zenyte.
Click the emerald.
Click the onyx.
Click the ruby.
Search the fireplace again for the sapphire key.
Search the fireplace and solve the puzzle for the sapphire key.
Go through the sapphire door.
This puzzle requires you to move the mirror to reflect the knives the murderer throws. You can tell which wardrobe the murderer will throw from by a black swirl that'll surround it.
Go through the sapphire door to continue.
Watch the killer's reveal cutscene.
Pick up the killer's knife.
Equip the killer's knife, then select Fight on Abigale (no actual combat will occur).
Attempt to go through the sapphire door.
Talk to Mandy just outside the manor to complete the quest.
